title: The Glass Coffin final
summary: A fearless tailor journeyed through an ancient pine forest when the ground gave way, plunging him into a subterranean vaulted chamber guarded by an ancient bearded dwarf....
full_text:
A fearless tailor journeyed through an ancient pine forest when the ground gave way, plunging him into a subterranean vaulted chamber guarded by an ancient bearded dwarf.

At the center of the hall, resting upon four crystal pillars, stood a radiant glass coffin illuminated by enchanted flames. Gazing through the crystal, the tailor beheld an extraordinarily beautiful maiden resting in enchanted slumber, her golden hair cascading like spun sunlight over her white silk dress.

The dwarf challenged the tailor to fight a fierce spectral stag to break the dark sorcery. With nimble bravery, the tailor dodged the beast's horns, trapped the creature in the underground arches, and shattered the dark seal upon the coffin.

The glass lid swung open, and the lovely princess awakened with a joyous gasp. She revealed that an evil wizard had imprisoned her and turned her father's grand castle into a tiny glass miniature.

The tailor smashed the wizard's vessel; the miniature expanded into a magnificent, flourishing castle upon the green hills. The grateful princess offered her hand to the tailor, and they celebrated their wedding before the assembled realm, ruling in peace and boundless joy.
moral: Steadfast valor breaks ancient sorceries and awakens sleeping beauty into lasting light.
